errors.text_span: utilizes a linear scale ranging from 64 to 256, with tick labels at every 64 increments
errors.evidence: The x-axis scale is not linear; the labels are 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, which represents a logarithmic (base 2) scale. The range starts at 16, not 64. The increments are not a fixed value of 64.
The y-axis label is "Eval PPL.", including the period at the end.
The markers for the blue line representing MoHD are squares, not circles.
The blue line starts at an x-value of 16 (not 64) with a y-value of approximately 10.4 (not 10.0). The value at x=64 is approximately 10.5.
The value of the blue line at x=256 is approximately 10.6, not 10.9.
The red dashed line is at a constant value of approximately 11.6, not 11.9.
The red line is constant across the entire displayed x-axis range, it does not start at x=64.
